title: PreflightResult
description: The setup-preflight finding contract: what daemon/setup-preflight.ts's runSetupPreflight returns for a proposed leadwright setup (org chart + charter(s) + daemon config), with no daemon running and no leads root required. GENERATED from lib/preflight-contract.ts by scripts/generate-preflight-schema.ts — do not hand-edit. `ok` is false iff at least one `MUSS`-layer finding is unsatisfied; `KANN`/`advisory` findings never affect it. `unverifiable: true` marks a finding this repo cannot check at all (always paired with satisfied: true) — e.g. whether a webui `projects` id or `webuiBaseUrl` is real and reachable; a caller must check those on its own side.
